title: The Wurzels - Combine Harvester (Brand New Key) [totp2]
summary: A Top of the Pops performance of The Wurzels' 1976 novelty hit Combine Harvester (Brand New Key). It is a West Country English comic cover of a pop song.
why: Posted as context for the song reference in the title of a story about a combine harvester software lock, and as a joke elsewhere.
